state:
Goal `core-reflect-classinfo-and-1-more` (dossier), stage 2. `Core\Reflect\ConstantInfo` is
complete. In `ClassInfo`, `attributes`, `call`, `constant`, `constants`, `get`, `construct`,
`methods`, `hasMethod` and `set` are complete. **Still owed, every proof of each: `name`,
`properties`, `readableProperties` and `hasProperty`.** The group gate
(`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Reflect\ClassInfo'`) counts 13 members and names these
four. Earlier handoffs never listed them, and nothing excuses them.

The `set` attack found a memory-safety hole in the shared erased write:
`nvs-runtime/erased-write-checks-no-class` (gap record, milestone M10). An object of any class
can be written into a field declared as another class, through `ClassInfo::set` or a `mixed`
receiver. `docs/examples/core/Reflect-ClassInfo/set/04-an-object-of-the-wrong-class-is-refused.nvs`
is marked with that gap and counts as `known-gap`. A bench that indexes an array with a `uint`
allocates twice per read. Index with `($i % n) as int`, which allocates nothing.

items.text: **`Core\Reflect\ClassInfo::name`** — about, examples, hostile, perf, Rust test, and a `covers:` marker on a `.nvst` case that calls `->name()` on a description (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2135`

**`Core\Reflect\ClassInfo::properties`** — the same proofs. The roster includes `private` properties with `isPublic` false. `class_info_methods_is_one_row_per_declared_method_in_name_order` in `mod tests` is the shape for the Rust test. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2152`

**`Core\Reflect\ClassInfo::readableProperties`** — the same proofs. It takes a call site, so the Rust test compares an outside site with an inside one, using `inside()` (`rule:security/reflection-enforces-visibility`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2183`

**`Core\Reflect\ClassInfo::hasProperty`** — the same proofs. `class_info_has_method_agrees_with_what_a_call_from_inside_the_class_reaches` is the agreement shape, with `get` in place of `call`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2232`

backlog: `nvs-runtime/erased-write-checks-no-class`: an erased write needs a resolved per-slot class or enum check (`data/gaps/nvs-runtime/erased-write-checks-no-class.json`).
An array read with a `uint` index allocates twice where an `int` index allocates nothing. Not checked where. Owner not decided (`crates/nvs-runtime`).
Re-record the benches of every `Core\Reflect*` group once `reflect.rs`'s code (not its tests) changes: `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<class>'`.
